mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Specify merge-free Pages generation and preservation rules.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The workflow checks out gh-pages in a separate directory and pushes that branch explicitly.
The updater scopes replacement to one branch download directory and rebuilds indexes from retained records.

allowedReads: Live and local gh-pages refs and tree objects
Temporary fixture outputs outside the repository
allowedWrites: Temporary fixture files under the operating-system temp directory
exclusions: No workflow run, push, deploy, branch, ref, index, source, or worktree mutation
No gh-pages checkout into the source worktree
No claim that the final shared browser app is already deployed
No deletion of current repository or Pages assets
acceptanceGate: The workflow regenerates gh-pages without merging it into source and preserves required download assets.
oneFixPlan: Prove separate-history generation, explicit gh-pages targeting, retained asset behavior, and current deployment gaps through static inspection plus an isolated updater fixture.
validationCommand: Re-read live Pages refs and workflow commands, rerun the updater fixture, verify retained hashes and expected outputs, and prove zero Git mutation.
cancellationRule: Stop before any remote write, deployment, ref update, or source-tree cleanup.
